name: codex-agents
description: A side pane «Codex»: which OpenAI Codex runs are working right now and what each is doing (state, time, last command or message, tokens), with the plan's usage on top; read from Codex's own session files, no model calls

taskDirs.title: Wrapper folders
taskDirs.description: Absolute (or ~/) folders where wrapper scripts keep codex-<id>.session, codex-<id>.jsonl or codex-<id>-review.jsonl: a run whose thread id one of them names is labelled by <id> instead of its prompt's first line.

windowHours.title: Window, hours
windowHours.description: Runs whose session file changed within this many hours are listed.

staleMinutes.title: Silent after, minutes
staleMinutes.description: An unfinished run whose session file has not changed for this long is shown as silent (◌ молчит) instead of running.

sessionsDir.title: Codex sessions folder
sessionsDir.description: Where Codex writes its rollout files; '' means ~/.codex/sessions.
